description: This Java class, BinaryValidationResult, encapsulates the result of a binary validation process, indicating success or failure and optionally providing a throwable reason for failure. It is designed to be used within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.common package, focusing on validation outcomes.

classes.name: BinaryValidationResult
classes.description: Immutable class representing the outcome of a validation, indicating success or failure with an optional Throwable reason for invalidity.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Creates a successful validation result with no reason for invalidity.

methods.name: invalid
methods.description: Creates a failed validation result with a specified Throwable as the reason for invalidity.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Returns true if the validation was successful (no reason for invalidity), false otherwise.

methods.name: getReasonForInvalidity
methods.description: Returns the Throwable reason for invalidity if present, null if the validation was successful.
